name: .330 Cal-235gr Claw Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist for dangerous game hunting is 1-12″ or faster. Recommended use: Dangerous Game Hunting or small game hunting to save pelts. The product page also says: "This pure copper dangerous game hunting bullet is designed for the 318 Westley Richards double rifle. This Claw Hammer™ is designed for 100% weight retention but soft enough to expand on the nose. We consider it an expanding solid."
